title: A Boundary--Residue Incidence Coalgebra for Associahedral Scattering Forms
summary: We introduce a boundary--residue incidence coalgebra associated with the face poset of a positive geometry and apply it to associahedral scattering forms. The construction is motivated by the analogy between the Connes--Kreimer coproduct on Feynman graphs and the recursive residue structure of canonical forms. For the Stasheff associahedron \(K_n\), whose faces are indexed by non-crossing dissections of an \((n+1)\)-gon, we prove that the incidence coproduct records all intermediate nested planar factorisation channels of the corresponding tree-level scalar amplitude.
